blocks.text: Khushki ke janwaron ko pani bachane ka masla hota hai, is liye yeh ammonia ko bohat se pani ke saath nahin nikal sakte. Yeh ammonia ko jigar mein urea mein badalte hain aur phir urea ko gurdon (kidneys) ke zariye nikalte hain. Urea ammonia se kam zehreeli hai. Ek gram urea ko be-zarar had tak patla karne ke liye 50 mL pani chahiye. Jo janwar apna bara nitrogen wala fuzla urea ki shakal mein nikalte hain unhen ureotelic kehte hain.

blocks.title: Insaan aur uric acid
blocks.text: Insaan bhi peshab mein thora sa uric acid nikalte hain. Uric acid purines ke tootne se banne wala zimni madda (by-product) hai; purines bohat si ghizaon mein hote hain, khaas taur par gosht aur kuch sabziyon mein. Uric acid jigar mein banta hai. Sehatmand logon mein banne wala zyada tar uric acid peshab mein nikal jata hai, lekin jab khoon mein uric acid zyada ho jaye to joron (joints) aur tissues mein uric acid ke crystals ban sakte hain, jin se gout jaisi dardnaak bimari hoti hai.
